derivation: apparently a strengthening form of the base of G5424 (φρήν);
def: to fence or inclose, i.e. (specially), to block up (figuratively, to silence)

occurrences.text: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
